title: Citrix Patches 10 Critical NetScaler Vulnerabilities
description: Citrix has released patches for 28 vulnerabilities in NetScaler ADC and Gateway, including 10 critical flaws primarily caused by memory overflow issues affecting various components such as Packet Processing, SMPP traffic, DNS/DoH, and others. Successful exploitation could cause unexpected behavior or denial-of-service (DoS) conditions. Additionally, a critical unauthenticated access vulnerability in NetScaler Console was patched. No exploitation in the wild has been reported.
